You can relax in them for a while to replenish your hearts.|Tips and Tricks|TotK}} ==Features and Overview== ==={{MM|-}}=== In {{MM}}, three Hot Springs can be found. The first one is located in the [[Goron Graveyard]]. After obtaining the [[Goron Mask]], [[Link]] can pull [[Darmani III]]'s grave to reveal the spring. Link can use an empty [[Bottle]] to scoop some [[Hot Spring Water]] and unfreeze one of the [[Goron]]s outside the graveyard, the [[Goron Elder#Majora's Mask|Goron Elder]], and the entrance to the second Hot Spring. The second one is located inside a [[Secret Grotto]] in the second of the [[Twin Islands]]. The last spring can be found [[Beneath the Well]] in [[Ikana Canyon]]. It is protected by a [[Dexihand]] and can be used to get some Hot Spring Water for one of the [[Gibdo]]s inside. ==={{TP|-}}=== In {{TP}}, there is a Hot Spring in [[Kakariko Village]] known as the [[Kakariko Hot Spring]] and another one in [[Death Mountain]]. The Kakariko Hot Spring is located atop the [[Elde Inn]] and is merely a small pond.{{Cite|{{Color TP|Green|Kakariko Hot Spring}}

Anyone and everyone is welcome. Soak slowly to warm your {{Color TP|Red|heart}}!|Sign|TP}} Link can only reach it via the Elde Inn. The Hot Spring from Death Mountain is a popular spot for Gorons.{{Cite|Without sumo matches, the hot spring is the only thing we have to look forward to, Brother.|Goron|TP}} There is also a [[Goron Store]] located in the far end of the Hot Spring. [[Link]] is able to scoop [[Hot Springwater]] from them using an [[Empty Bottle]]. He can also recover his [[Heart]]s by standing in Hot Springs.{{Cite|Sitting in a hot spring warms up your body and soul...and gradually fills you up with energy, Brother.|Goron|TP}} ==={{BotW|-}}=== In {{BotW}}, a number of Hot Springs can be found across the [[Eldin (Region)|Eldin]] [[Region]] and the [[Hebra Mountains]]. The Spring's warm waters will gradually replenish Link's [[Life Gauge|Hearts]] at a rate of half a [[Heart]] every two seconds, so long as he is at least waist-deep in the water. A number of Hot Springs in Eldin are named, including [[Gero Pond]], the [[Goron Hot Springs]], [[Lake Ferona]], and [[Lake Intenoch]]. Unnamed Hot Springs can also be found around the region. The various Hot Springs in Hebra are all named, including [[Goflam's Secret Hot Spring]], [[Sherfin's Secret Hot Spring]] and [[Sturnida Secret Hot Spring]]. There is also an isolated unnamed Hot Spring in [[West Necluda]] just south-southwest of [[Mount Rozudo]], and another located beneath [[Hyrule Castle (Dungeon)|Hyrule Castle]]. Link can also make [[Hard-Boiled Egg]]s by throwing [[Bird Egg]]s into Hot Springs. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ====List of Hot Springs==== {{Collapsible |header= Hot Springs |collapse= true |content= {{Data Table |game= TotK |columns= Hot Spring[Term][Nowrap], Location[Term], Depths/Surface Counterpart[Term][Nowrap] |- | Gero Pond | Eldin Canyon | N/A |- | Goflam's Secret Hot Spring | Hebra Mountains | Goflam's Lavafalls |- | Golow River | Eldin Canyon | N/A |- | Goron City | Eldin Canyon | N/A |- | Goron Hot Springs | Eldin Canyon | N/A |- | Goronbi River | Eldin Canyon | N/A |- | Gortram Cliff | Eldin Canyon | N/A |- | Gut Check Rock | Eldin Canyon | N/A |- | Lake Intenoch | Eldin Canyon | N/A |- | Lizard Lakes | Eldin Canyon | N/A |- | Meda Mountain | East Necluda | Meda Lavafalls |- | Rock-Roast Pond | Eldin Canyon | N/A |- | Sherfin's Secret Hot Spring | Hebra Mountains | Sherfin's Lavafalls |- | Simmerstone Springs | Eldin Canyon | N/A |- | Shrine of Resurrection | Great Plateau | Secret Spring of Revival |- | Sturnida Secret Hot Spring | Hebra Mountains | Sturnida Lavafalls |- | Secret Spring of Revival | Central Hyrule Depths | Shrine of Resurrection }} }} ==={{EoW|-}}=== {{Checklist |game= EoW |type= Objects |category= Objects in Echoes of Wisdom |needs= Detailed information on the following: * Where it can be found * Whether it can be interacted with and if it is important to the story or a Quest * Whether it can be copied as an Echo }} {{Stub|EoW}} Hot Springs appear atop the [[Eldin Volcano]]. ==Trivia== * In {{BotW}}, the sound effect for being healed by a Hot Spring will be cut off if [[Link]] only has a quarter of a [[Heart]]'s worth of damage.
